value.rationale: The k two-agent-group case is the smallest nontrivial participant-granularity of the 2026 distributed model, whose general sum-cost approximation remains between 3-2/k and 3+2/k. The new result closes that interval exactly for the paired regime, for all k, for every deterministic local rule, and even for arbitrary metric spaces. It supplies a tight worst-case quantitative price of delegation, not just a routine numerical tabulation; its strict domain and already-known lower example are acknowledged.
